title: Sum of Rademacher summands
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be real coefficients, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The sum of the Rademacher summands $a_i x_i$ is the linear form $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each coordinate
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
